description: Cykelställ is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lomma kommun. Bike racks in Lomma municipality. Coordinates in WGS84 (EPSG: 4326). Coverage: Lomma kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Bike rack" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lomma kommun. Its keywords include cykelställ, bike rack. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
